name: alert
description: A static callout box (Alert, AlertTitle, AlertDescription) with default and destructive variants — an inline heads-up that's part of the page, not a transient toast and not an async error-with-retry. Sets no ARIA role by default so it never interrupts a screen reader; add role=alert or role=status yourself when it appears dynamically.

notes: No role by default — a static callout shouldn't interrupt assistive tech; add role=alert (assertive) or role=status (polite) when it appears in response to an action
Variant colour is reinforced by the title/description text, never conveyed by colour alone
Title and description are plain text elements with no imposed heading level

intents: a static alert / callout / notice box
an inline info or warning panel on a page
a heads-up message with a title and description
examples: <Alert variant="destructive" role="alert"><AlertTitle>Payment failed</AlertTitle><AlertDescription>Your card was declined.</AlertDescription></Alert>
